chapter.verse: Tu-in nipikal ni masani, khuavak ma zingsang tuungin hankhuk ah Magdala khuami Mary pai a, hankhuk hukna suangtum kilikkhia khina om mu hi.
Tua ciangin amah tai-in Simon Peter leh Jesu' itdeuh nungzui a dang khatpa' kiang pai a, “Amaute in hankhuk pan Topa lakhia khin uh a, koi ah sial uh hiam cih ka thei kei uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua hangin nungzui a dang khatpa tawh Peter paikhia a, hankhuk lam manawh uh hi.
A nihun taikhawm uh a, ahih hangin nungzui a dang khatpa in Peter makhelh ahih manin hankhuk tung masa hi.
Kunsukin a et leh puannel dialte a kizal mu a, ahih hangin amah lutsuk lo hi.
Tua ciangin ama' zom ah Simon Peter zong tungin hankhuk sung lutsuk hi. Puannel dialte a kizal mu a,
Jesu' lu tunna-a kizang mainul ahihleh puannel dialte tawh kizalkhawm lo-in mun khat ah a tuamin a kikhepsa-in om hi.
Hankhuk a tung masa nungzui a dang khatpa zong lutsuk a, mu-in um hi.
A hang pen tua hunin amaute in Jesu thokik ding cih Pasian' Laibu' genna tel nailo uh hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite a inn uhah ciah uh hi.
Ahih hangin Mary ahihleh hankhuk pualam ah dingin kap a, a kah kawmin kunin hankhuk sung ensuk hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu' luang a kisialna mun ah vanmi nih, a lukhung ah khat, a khekhuantaw ah khat, puan paak silhin a tu mu hi.
Tua vanmite in Mary' kiangah, “Numei aw, bang hangin kap na hi hiam?” a cih uhleh Mary in, “Amaute in ka Topa paikhiatpih khin uh a, koi ah koih uh cih ka thei kei hi,” ci hi.
A cih khit ciangin a kiheileh Jesu a ding mu a, ahih hangin Jesu ahihlam thei tuanlo hi.

Jesu in, “Numei aw, bang hangin kap na hi hiam? Kua zong na hi hiam?” ci hi. Mary in huancingpa sa ahih manin, “Sya aw, amah puakhia khin na hihleh na sialna mun hong gen in. Amah ka va la ding hi,” ci hi
Jesu in, “Mary,” ci-in a sap leh Mary kihei a, Hebrew-kam tawh (“Sya” cihna ahi), “Rabonni!” ci-in dawng hi.

Jesu in, “Pa' kiangah kahto nailo ka hih manin kei hong len kei phot in. Ka sanggamte' kiangah va pai inla, ‘Keima' Pa leh nomau' Pa, keima' Pasian leh nomau' Pasian' kiangah ka kahto ding hi,’ ci, va cizaw in,” ci hi.
Magdala khuami Mary zong pai-in nungzuite' kiangah, “Topa ka mu khinzo hi,” ci-in tangko a, hih thute ama' kiangah gen ahihna thu zong pulak hi.

Tua ni, nipikal sunga ni masani, a nitak ciangin Jew mite a kihtakna uh tawh kongpi kilehkalh-a kikaikhawm nungzuite' omna ah Jesu hong pai-in amaute' lakah hong ding a, “Nopna lemna ngah ta un,” ci hi.
A cih khit ciangin nungzuite' kiangah a khutte leh a pang lak hi. Nungzuite zong Topa a muh uh ciangin nuam mahmah uh hi.
Jesu in amaute hopih leuleu a, “Nopna lemna ngah ta un. Pa in kei hong sawl bangin ke'n zong note kong sawl ding hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu a gen khit ciangin amau' tungah a hu sang a, “Kha Siangtho na sang un.
Mite' mawhna na maisak uhleh amaute a mawhna uh a mai hi a, na maisak kei uhleh amaute a mawhna uh a mailo ahi hi,” ci hi.
Jesu' hong pai hunin sawmlenihte laka khat ahi, (Didymus a kici) Thomas pen amau tawh om lo hi.

Tua ciangin nungzui dangte in ama' kiangah, “Topa ka mu khin uh hi,” ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Thomas in, “Ama' khutpek ah siktukkilh mapawn mu-in tua mapawn sungah ka khutme ka khumkhak mateng leh a pang ah zong ka khutme ka khumkhak mateng ka um ngeikei ding hi,” ci hi.
Ni giat a cin ni-in Jesu' nungzuite inn sungah om leuleu uh a, Thomas zong amaute tawh om hi. Kongkhakte kilehkalh napi-in Jesu hong pai-in amaute' lakah hong ding a, “Nopna lemna ngah ta un,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Thomas' kiangah, “Na khutme hih takah hong koih inla ka khutte veel in. Na khut zan inla ka pang sungah khum in. Umlah nawnkei inla um ta in,” ci hi.
Thomas in, “Ka Topa leh ka Pasian!” ci-in dawng hi.
Jesu in, “Nong muh ciang bekin hong um na hi hiam? Mu nailo pi-a a umte thuphangah ahi hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in nungzuite' muhna ah kihilna lim a dang tampitak bawl lai a, tuate hih laibu sungah kigelh lo hi.
Hih a kigelhte pen Jesu, Pasian' Tapa, Khris ahihna thu na up theih nading uh leh ama' min hangin tua upna tawh nuntakna na ngah theih nading uh ahi hi.
